metadata.notes: Baseline for sift-email using Gmail's Important mark and star, a time-based search for new mail, and a daily review of how the user handles mail (PR #129, issue #128), evals 1-25, two runs each, with run-mcp-trials.sh against the Gmail, Claude Docs, and Contacts stubs. Both runs were on SKILL.md as of commit 323be7f, run in parallel with separate trial directories under $TMPDIR. Every eval prompt starts with /sift-email. Runs were on 2026-10-25 in the rubric timezone; fixtures are anchored to 2026-10-10 and shifted two weeks by fixture-dates.py, eval 11's already-ran entry follows the trial clock ({{today:America/Chicago}}), and graders held the run date to the date the run's clock gave. Every expectation passed in both runs. Not graded: the Bulk and Junk split for marketing and list mail varies between runs (evals 2, 14, and 19); category labels the eval's rubric doesn't name are sometimes created (AI/Newsletter, AI/Delivery, AI/Appointment); a changelog entry for sift's own (inferred) notes appears in some runs and not others; one run heading in eval 1 landed above the Runs intro; the Daily review note usually sits in the run summary rather than on its own line; and log formatting varies (bullets, bold, em dashes).
